releaseNotes: Legacy text formatting popups are now permanently suppressed in Text mode to stop the brief flash seen on BOOX
The stable text options row now includes the missing text colors plus alignment, presets, list, checklist and highlight controls
Manual resize now uses a document-level pointer/touch drag implementation with a larger BOOX-safe handle
Automatic text block growth again expands to the right first and then downward when wrapping is required
Width and height are persisted after manual resize, automatic growth and before tool switches
Textblock löschen keeps the LuMa confirmation dialog with Abbrechen and Löschen
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
